resources.string: Wind down: tap to start your good night routine.
A daily notification that starts your good night routine. You can also say \"remind me to go to bed at 11:30 every day\".
Remind me to go to bed
Alarms Lumi set in your clock app (for example \"wake me at 7 with 3 alarms every 10 minutes\"). Deleting here removes them from the clock.
